text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy~...
I couldn't run the way I wanted to at all...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
choice_data_list: Even so, you didn't give up on the race until the very end.
Let's retrain so you can run in your own true style!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her drive to win came through clearly in her running.
I reassure her that someday, it will surely lead to results.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you're so sweet, Trainy.
Then again, you're right, I've been practicing super hard too.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I can't stop here.
Next time, I'll aim higher... no, I'll win!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie, I'm gonna give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Back to the drawing board, huh...?
Well, everyone was really strong, so it makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
I want to be able to run in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'll practice a ton and win next time for sure!
choice_data_list: I'll lead you to victory. I'll pave the way for it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Alright, no more moping around!
I'm gonna get so, so much stronger~~~!
